title: API response missing fields
description: The API response no longer contains the expected fields after the release. Reported via email.
resolution: Restored the removed fields in the response and released a hotfix for backward compatibility. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Rate limit errors on API
description: Integration is receiving 429 Too Many Requests during normal usage. Escalated from tier 1.
resolution: Raised the rate limit for the partner's key and advised exponential backoff on retries. Customer confirmed the issue is resolved.

title: Account locked after failed attempts
description: User account is locked and the unlock email never arrives. Occurred on mobile app.
resolution: Unlocked the account manually and resent the unlock email after correcting the user's email address. Verified fix in production.

title: Confirmation emails not delivered
description: Customers are not receiving order confirmation emails. Affects a single customer.
resolution: SPF and DKIM records were missing for the sending domain; added them and delivery recovered. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Refund failed at gateway
description: Refund request was rejected by the gateway with a failure status. Started after the latest release.
resolution: Gateway rejected the refund because the original transaction was past the refund window; issued a manual bank transfer instead. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: API requests timing out
description: Partner integration requests time out after 30 seconds. Started after the latest release.
resolution: Added a missing database index behind the slow query; response times dropped below the timeout. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Emails landing in spam
description: Transactional emails are being delivered to the spam folder. Escalated from tier 1.
resolution: Moved transactional emails to a dedicated sending domain with proper authentication, which improved inbox placement. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Refund stuck in initiated status
description: Refund has been in initiated status for several days. Occurred on mobile app.
resolution: Re-triggered the stuck refund through the gateway dashboard and confirmed the status changed to processed. Documented in the runbook.

title: Two-factor code not accepted
description: The one-time code from the authenticator app is rejected as invalid. Reported via chat.
resolution: Device clock was out of sync so codes were rejected; synced the time and the code was accepted. Verified fix in production.

title: Duplicate notification sent
description: Customer received the same alert three times. Started after the latest release.
resolution: Notification worker retried the job after a timeout; added a de-duplication key so each alert is sent once. Monitored for 48 hours with no recurrence.

title: Webhook delivery failing
description: Our webhook endpoint calls fail with 502 from the gateway. Occurred on the web app.
resolution: Upstream service was restarting during deploys; enabled webhook retries so deliveries succeed after the restart. Monitored for 48 hours with no recurrence.

title: Refund to wrong payment method
description: Refund was sent to a wallet instead of the original card. Raised by an enterprise account.
resolution: Refund routed to the original payment source after the wallet credit was reversed. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Refund shows processed but no money
description: The order shows refund processed but the amount is not in the customer's account. Seen by multiple customers this week.
resolution: Shared the bank reference number with the customer; the bank credited the amount after its settlement cycle. Monitored for 48 hours with no recurrence.

title: SMS OTP not received
description: Users do not receive the SMS one-time password during signup. Affects a single customer.
resolution: SMS provider had throttled the sender ID; switched to the approved sender and OTPs were delivered. Documented in the runbook.

title: Session expires immediately after login
description: User is logged out within seconds and redirected to the login page. Reported via email.
resolution: Session cookie was being rejected because of a domain mismatch; corrected the cookie domain setting. Verified fix in production.

title: Push notifications not appearing
description: Mobile push notifications are not showing up for some users. Affects a single customer.
resolution: Device token had expired; the app re-registered the push token after an update. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Reset password link expired
description: Password reset email link shows expired even when opened right away. Escalated from tier 1.
resolution: Reset token lifetime was too short due to a config error; increased it and reissued the link. Verified fix in production.

title: Refund not received
description: Customer cancelled the order two weeks ago and still has not received the refund. Affects a single customer.
resolution: Refund had been submitted to the bank; provided the ARN so the customer could track it, funds arrived in 5-7 business days. Customer confirmed the issue is resolved.

title: 401 Unauthorized with valid API key
description: Client receives 401 responses even though the API key is valid. Seen by multiple customers this week.
resolution: API key was scoped to the sandbox environment; issued a production key and requests succeeded. Closed after customer confirmation.

title: Cannot log in after password reset
description: User resets the password but login still says invalid credentials. Escalated from tier 1.
resolution: Cleared the user's stale sessions and tokens server-side; user logged in with the new password. Documented in the runbook.
